messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up 12 I ran a light audit-coverage pass across API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Found a handful of customer-facing evidence gaps that may fail compliance reviews. Need owners and triage.

sam: ok list the gaps?

morgan: short list: API gateway missing blocked_request events with client metadata (cert_subject, app_id). Auth: token_refresh and service-account key rotation events missing rotation_reason & actor_ip. Console: admin_impersonation and account_settings.change not consistently emitted. Billing: invoice_download not logged (we only log view). Runtime: model-deploy lacks rollbacks and fallback reasons.

alina: KMS: many services only log key_id. Customers ask for key provenance (key_id + rotation_reason + previous_key_id). Also RBAC changes should include before/after role lists and who initiated.

sam: agree on RBAC diffs. propose token_refresh schema snippet: 

```json
{
  "event_type": "token.refresh",
  "actor_id": "user:1234",
  "client_ip": "3.4.5.6",
  "outcome": "success",
  "method": "refresh_token",
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "meta": {"old_token_id": "t-abc","new_token_id": "t-def"}
}
```

sam: marking schema_version so we can evolve fields later.

kai: quick grep shows api-gw missing client_cert_subject; auth-service missing rotation_reason; console missing admin_impersonation; billing missing invoice_download.

morgan: customer-facing validation plan: 1) compatibility check + migration guide, 2) enterprise opt-in richer stream (client_geo, key_arn) behind feature-flag, 3) sampling vs full-evidence modes with retention choices.

jordan: i'll take API gateway and console tickets. will open and loop QA.

morgan: assign: api-gw -> @jordan, auth -> @alina, billing -> @sam, runtime -> @kai. i'll coordinate rollout and customer comms.

auditeer-bot: emitted sample event for validation: {"event_type": "audit.sample", "svc": "api-gateway", "id": "e-20260401-01", "status": "emitted"}

alina: KMS question: log full ARN or hashed id? auditors want ARN but storing sensitive ARNs in default logs is problematic. suggestion: default stream -> hashed_kid, long-term secure store -> full ARN with access control; export includes full ARN on request.

sam: add key_identifier enum ["arn","kid_hash"] and access_level tag.

kai: triage suggestion: central matrix (service x event_type) with columns: current_coverage(Y/partial/N), missing_fields, owner, ETA, customer_impact. then bulk-create backlog prioritized by compliance/regulatory impact.

morgan: sample csv line: 
```
service,event_type,current_coverage,missing_fields,owner,priority,notes
api-gateway,request.blocked,partial,client_cert_subject;client_app_id,jordan,P1,required for 3rd-party audit evidence
```

morgan: action items:
- jordan: open api-gateway + console tickets (ETA 48h)
- alina: spec KMS & RBAC-diff schema additions + retention implications (ETA 72h)
- sam: submit token_refresh schema PR & validators (ETA 48h)
- kai: produce matrix + attach grep output (ETA 24h)
- morgan: draft customer comms + enterprise feature-flag plan (ETA 72h)

jordan: will open and ping channel when done

sam: starting PR in infra/audit-schemas and will tag eng-security

morgan: let's keep default schema conservative (no PII). enterprise toggle for richer fields with consent. checkpoint in 72h. :calendar:
